_comment: Channel registry. Single source of truth for capture. Adding a station is a config change, never a code change.

capture._note: Channel /live URL, NOT a watch URL. A 24/7 channel rotates its video id: the original watch URL for Inooro TV was already dead when checked on 2026-09-23. Always resolve the channel's current live video.

capture.known_issue: YouTube live stalls after ~2s from this network (HLS 1s DVR chunks; ffmpeg freezes at time=00:00:01.99). Inooro TV on the same platform works, so this is stream-specific, not platform-wide. Luo coverage is unaffected — Ramogi FM captures normally. Retry periodically; consider an SDR node for Nyanza in Phase 2.

capture._note: Direct CDN endpoint, verified by 8s ffmpeg capture. Resolved from the broadcaster's own player API rather than an aggregator re-host, so there is no third-party layer to break.
